title.narrative: Enhancing Women and Girls¿ Leadership in Climate Change Adaptation in the Thar Desert, India

description.narrative: Overall objective of the project is to contribute to the enhanced leadership of women and girls, and greater gender equality, in drought mitigation, Natural Resource Management (NRM) and climate change adaptation in the Thar Desert of India.
